numeric_adjacency_proxy.definition: Two present numeric stems n and n+1.

missing_evidence: source video or frame sequence identifiers
capture session, route, date and time
proposed_procedure: Request creator-provided video, scene, capture-session and physical-sign metadata.
Generate candidate clusters using numeric adjacency and visual near-duplicate similarity.
Require manual domain review of every candidate cluster.
Record stem, proposed group_id, evidence type, reviewer, review date and confidence.
Create stratified group-aware train, validation and quarantined test manifests only after adjudication.
Verify zero group overlap and report per-class support before authorizing experiments.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not treat numeric adjacency as ground truth.
Do not use stem divided by a fixed window size as final group_id.
Do not reuse the current train/test split as an independent holdout.
Do not train before Gate 0 passes.
